title: MEIKO — Training For A Dream♪〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: A morning run, a hundred reps of exercises that we can do in our spare time and...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Your training schedules seem to be coming along nicely.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks. I wouldn't have been able to do this without you, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What you said helped me figure out which exercises to choose, how many reps to do and when.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, have you finished coming up with those training schedules for Shinobi Battle?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sure. Actually, I'd like to hear what you guys think. Let me know if anything sticks out to you.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Based on what I overheard just now, what you came up with sounded pretty intense.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Run five kilometers in the morning, do three sets of a hundred squats and twenty-second planks, and then go to school...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I get that you guys don't have a lot of time to train for this, but talk about going full throttle...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But considering the strength and stamina they're going to need, they're going to have to push themselves at least this hard...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Right.
I crammed in everything that I thought we could do.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So it's going to come down to whether or not those two can hang on...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Based on what you've all told me about how they train and exercise on a regular basis, I believe they'll be able to get through this.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, I know!
Len, KAITO, would you two be up for a little challenge?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: These training schedules were designed with two boys in mind, yes?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, I thought you two could do a quick test run for us...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess we are the only ones you can ask.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay. Then, let's give it a try.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Thank you both very much...
Your sacrifice will not go to waste.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Let's reorder the exercises that those two will be doing, and adjust the reps for each.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But we've only talked about what they'll be doing in the morning. If possible, I'd also like to discuss their schedules for the afternoon...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Here's some water, you two.
I'll use these fans to cool you off.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I don't think Len and KAITO are going to be able to move for a little while...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I've been training with you and the others, Haruka, so I should be able to provide you with some good data!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'd like to help as well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Doing every set might not be possible, but we should be able to help you come up with the best order for these exercises.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I really appreciate you girls' commitment.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, just do the exercises in the order I tell you!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Are you okay, everyone?! I'll get you some water now!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sob*
Rin... Are my arms still attached to my body...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, don't worry! They still are!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
They're also fine!
Stay with me, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you for helping me with this, Minori...
I know you're really sore, so I'll carry you home.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
That may've been the final blow...
How are you two feeling, Shizuku, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay... I'd like to take a break, but I think I'll manage...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm just glad that we were able to figure out the best order for these exercises...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I really appreciate it, everyone.
Thank you all for your hard work.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: All that's left is to have your teammates try out the completed schedules, no?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I have a friend who knows Tenma and Shinonome pretty well, so I might ask her for some advice before doing that.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sounds good. But I'm sure they'll both be fine.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Akito's a good guy who always does his best when he's up against a serious challenge.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So I'm sure they'll both do their very best to meet your effort and expectations, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
No, I should be the one thanking you!
I had a lot of fun working on this with you♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Go out there and win!
I believe in you, Haruka!
